title: Aliens call humans water beings
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Aliens call humans water beings, about early 1990s at Base 2, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> He always referred to us as water vessels or water beings, water humans.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US electronic spying agency, hired him to talk with aliens, told podcast host Jesse Michels about his contact in the early 1990s at a place he calls Base 2. He says the being he communicated with always referred to humans as water vessels, water beings or water humans.
